name: ULTRAMARINES: KAIUS KONORIUS
description:
Kaius Konorius is a master duellist who neither xenos swarm nor infernal champion can stand against. This grizzled blademaster fought alongside Marneus Calgar and Chaplain Cassius when all three were neophytes. He has honed his skills tirelessly, eschewing command in favour of martial excellence. Calgar summoned his old comrade to serve as his champion in the wake of a near‑fatal duel against Abaddon the Despoiler.

Calgar's Champion

This multipart plastic kit builds Kaius Konorius, a veteran bodyguard for your Ultramarines army in games of Warhammer 40,000. Equipped with Severance and Rebuke, his master-crafted power weapons, he is a terror for both hordes of enemies and priority targets. A heavy bolt pistol allows Kaius to soften up a foe before he closes in. Few can stand against him in combat, making him an ideal protector for your most important leaders. He can be assembled with either a plumed helmet or bare head.

Contents:
– 17 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 40mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
